product: A blog post: why our deploys got slower after moving to a monorepo
audience: Engineers at small companies considering a monorepo
task: An article of 800 to 1,200 words with one figure and the numbers below.
facts: Median CI time went from 6 min (12 repos) to 19 min (one repo) in the first month

Fix: affected-target detection; median back to 7 min 30 s after 3 weeks
Cache hit rate rose from 0% to 71%
Still slower for changes to the shared types package (median 16 min)
mustInclude: The before, after and fix numbers with their windows
